capability: Implement the Application and Infrastructure backend slice for a future user-facing distribution Launcher that routes a healthy installation to the existing immutable Bootstrap and permits first-install Setup only when root and durable state are genuinely absent; production host, shortcut, packaging and clean-machine delivery remain open until the v1.0.6 integration gate
searchEvidence: VersionManagementExperience.Registry is the sole Registry to Catalog to package-admission owner and already verifies Registry publication, Catalog identity and package identity without requiring a second parser or updater.

FileSystemManagedVersionRepository already owns stable package capture, closed ZIP verification, atomic version promotion and installed inventory; ManagedVersionSeedBootstrapper already owns canonical unbound-seed admission and durable root binding.

StableManagedExecutableLaunchLease already owns PE, size and SHA-256 verification through a deny-write/delete handle held until process creation; healthy entry and post-install Bootstrap handoff extend that one custody owner.

ManagedPackageVerifier remains the sole ZIP plan, relative-entry admission, copy and source-hash owner. Ordinary update and first-install Setup both consume that plan through the same WindowsStablePathCustody relative OBJ_DONT_REPARSE write tree; no path-based fallback or second extractor remains.

The shared write tree reserves exact package files, implicit directories and expanded bytes, holds created descendants through validation, and promotes without replacement. Ordinary install captures immutable custody directly; Setup transfers custody from its still-held promoted whole-root handle, proves identical root file identity before releasing the original handle, and then performs complete closed-root verification. Unsafe cleanup is never replaced by recursive path deletion; a typed recovery residue is retained when exact held-handle cleanup cannot complete.

InheritedManagedBootstrapIdentityContext is the sole bounded environment parser for exact Bootstrap filename, positive length and lowercase SHA-256. Bootstrap captures and clears ambient identity on every invocation; only genuine inherited startup may propagate the explicit trusted value, so manual or malformed ambient state cannot be laundered through a managed child lifetime.

Fresh Setup consumes the shared package admission result but additionally requires its typed schema-1.2 managed-Launcher capability. Schema 1.1 remains readable for historical installed inventory and cannot be promoted into a first installation that Bootstrap cannot launch.

The Setup use case records the irreversible promotion boundary independently from process receipt state. Cancellation after that boundary is InstalledButLaunchFailed or RecoveryRequired, never an ordinary Cancelled result.

ADR 0051 and ADR 0056 define the managed root, immutable Bootstrap trust anchor and Bootstrap-free version ZIP, while the current release contract explicitly stops at a deterministic lab and therefore requires an installer-level decision before production Setup exists.

Independent architecture and release tie-break reviews selected one external distribution Launcher plus the existing small immutable Bootstrap, rejected a second public Setup executable and a self-installing fat Bootstrap, and required a local-only fast path with no Registry, Catalog, package or full-inventory access.
semanticOwner: VersionManagement Application owns the single LaunchInstalled/ShowSetup/RecoveryRequired classification and immutable fresh-install admission; VersionManagement Infrastructure owns bounded root observation/materialization and stable executable custody; the existing Bootstrap and Version Launcher remain the only READY/LKG owners; protected release tooling owns the separate distribution-Launcher evidence set
terminalContract: Every distribution Launcher invocation performs bounded local-only classification before any source access. A healthy exact root/state is handed to the existing immutable Bootstrap; genuinely missing state plus a genuinely absent residue-free root shows Setup; all partial, moved, foreign, damaged, busy, timed-out or ambiguous facts fail closed and never fall through to Setup. The distribution Launcher is delivery media rather than installation provenance: if exact state, root, marker and staging are all absent, its remaining download copy does not prevent Setup and no provenance sidecar or extra startup I/O is added. Read-only classification takes no writer lease; Bootstrap and Setup acquire the existing writer authority and repeat the exact consumed facts immediately before mutation. Setup proves the exact existing parent is a writable local non-reparse destination before payload or Registry/Catalog/package access, repeats that admission under the lease, and creates staging relative to held handles with atomic create-and-open semantics. Ordinary update and first-install Setup use the same Windows held-handle, relative, no-follow write tree and the same ManagedPackageVerifier plan/copy/hash owner; there is no concrete-type fallback, path-based nested extraction, or recursive staging cleanup. The write tree reserves package files, implicit directories and expanded bytes independently and promotes without replacement. Ordinary install captures its promoted version directly; Setup verifies staged package content, keeps the exact whole-root handle open across promotion, transfers it handle-to-handle to immutable custody after proving identical root file identity, and then repeats complete closed-root verification before durable state can commit. Unsafe exact-handle cleanup leaves typed recovery residue instead of following a replaced path. Healthy startup makes zero Registry, Catalog, package, network and full-inventory calls. Local state/exact-root health classification targets 100 ms P95 and has a 250 ms hard cutoff even when a read-only adapter ignores cancellation; late results cannot route or start a process. Progress appears only after 250 ms. A fresh per-invocation outer Bootstrap Job uses the deterministic state-path prefix while the exact state-path writer lease remains the serialization authority. Executables are hashed once through stable custody and complete local admission has a two-second hard deadline split into 1.5 seconds operation plus 0.5 seconds cleanup. Bootstrap captures and clears ambient descriptor identity on every invocation; only a complete inherited startup may explicitly propagate it, so missing, malformed, manual or tampered identity grants no restart authority. Setup accepts only a typed schema-1.2 candidate with the supported managed Launcher, revalidates that immutable Registry/Catalog/package token, then under the existing writer lease atomically materializes the captured distribution Launcher, descriptor-bound Bootstrap, one admitted version and one canonical unbound seed. Setup never writes per-user version state or PendingActivation. Cancellation after irreversible promotion is InstalledButLaunchFailed or RecoveryRequired, never ordinary Cancelled. Any residue observed by a later process is RecoveryRequired and belongs to RECOVERY-105-01. Version ZIPs remain unchanged and Bootstrap-free; the distribution Launcher has a separate closed evidence set and is not delivered until the v1.0.6 integrated Setup/recovery gate passes.

designReview.evidence: Fixed-head reviews at 807b9cde9bdccbab85a9d94527924c155cc6f09d selected a single public distribution Launcher with an internal Setup branch and preserved the existing small immutable Bootstrap. They required one Application entry owner, genuine-absence-only Setup, no later-process Setup retry, bounded local-only startup, one stable executable hash per launch, no normal-start seed transaction, a non-circular embedded Bootstrap descriptor, and a separate external evidence set. The previous separate Setup.exe draft was rejected and replaced before production implementation continued.

finalReview.evidence: Independent exact-head R3 architecture/security review approved implementation 0127f1fb2ed640e59e0c5b06b1d778bd7c01fae3 (tree 50b10fa53615c3d600ad9ecfc292d3403cd8209e; sole base 807b9cde9bdccbab85a9d94527924c155cc6f09d). The complete SETUP-104 diff preserves one Application entry/setup owner, one Registry/Catalog/package admission path, one ManagedPackageVerifier ZIP plan/copy/hash owner, and one WindowsStablePathCustody held-handle no-follow write/promotion/cleanup owner. Ordinary update and Setup share that custody; exact topology/FileId snapshots, same-root non-replacing promotion, post-rename capture, cancellation/collision/substitution handling, and exact cleanup fail closed without recursive fallback. Explicit inherited Bootstrap identity is the only restart authority; manual or malformed context cannot acquire it. No firmware/profile/range/CRC/naming/golden authority changed. Prior P2 duplicate-native-owner and post-promotion-cancellation gaps are closed. Exact code-size gates are 128423 full, 90765 runtime, 40058 Application, and 25994 Infrastructure; policy validation is clean and 16/16 tests pass. No P0/P1/P2 remain.
